package.title: Scarcity in an age of AI abundance
package.data_as_of: The paper as accepted on 3 August 2026, with the wording changes made in proof. The tests of the added page were written on 22 November 2026; no reading of them has been taken.
package.units: There are no measured quantities. Table 1 holds signs: ++, +, 0, - and --, stored also as scores from 2 to -2. A sign is the direction the paper expects for a change in rent income; it has no size.

licence.condition: Reuse of the results is allowed with credit to the paper.
licence.third_party_data: Nothing in this record comes from a third party. The paper is open access under CC BY 4.0, the licence of Asian Review of Political Economy, and the passages of it held in the tables are under that licence.

package.cite_as: Papadogiannis, A. (2027). Scarcity in an age of AI abundance. Asian Review of Political Economy, forthcoming. https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.5924462
package.cite_package: Papadogiannis, A. (2026). Scarcity in an age of AI abundance. Replication package, version 1.0.0. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24441153
package.describe_as: Papadogiannis (forthcoming), "Scarcity in an age of AI abundance", Asian Review of Political Economy, https://doi.org/10.1007/s44216-026-00090-y, with the record of its definitions, model and table.

tables.what: Table 1 of the paper, one row per actor or industry: the expected direction of each layer's contribution to rent income, and the net direction. Schematic and conjectural; the article says the entries are not forecasts.

columns.id: identifier of the row: the panel letter and the position in the panel, A1 to E4
columns.panel: panel of the table, A to E
columns.panel_title: title of the panel, as printed
columns.actor: actor or industry, as printed in bold in the table
columns.note: the small print under the actor's name, as printed; empty where the table has none
columns.physical: sign of the contribution of layer 1, physical, to the change in the actor's rent income: ++, +, 0, - or --
columns.net: the implied direction of the change in the actor's total rent income, as printed; it cannot be recomputed from the five signs, because their sizes are not given
columns.tests: the tests of outputs/tests.csv that use this row, separated by a space; empty for the 14 rows that no test uses

tables.what: The same table with one row per actor and column, for filtering: 24 actors times five layers and the net column.

columns.id: identifier of the actor's row in table1.csv
columns.column: physical, infrastructural, capabilities, institutional, jurisdictional, or net
columns.layer_number: 1 to 5 for a layer; empty for the net column
columns.score: the sign as a whole number from 2 to -2, for sorting only; not a measured size and not to be summed

tables.what: The five layers of scarcity, in the article's words.

columns.name: name of the layer
columns.holds: what the layer consists of, from the article's list of the five layers, citations removed
columns.prediction: the sentence that follows the word 'Prediction:' in the article's section on that layer

tables.what: The three central claims, as listed in the introduction.

columns.title: the claim in a few words, as printed in bold
columns.text: the article's explanation of the claim

tables.what: Seven terms of the paper, each with the passage of the article that defines it.

columns.short: its abbreviation, where the article uses one
columns.section: the section of the article the passage is taken from
columns.text: the passage, word for word, citations removed; it can be a phrase, and it can refer to text that stands before it in the article

tables.what: The model of the section 'A compact mathematical formulation': six equations, the definition of AEA, the proposition and its proof.

columns.item: Equation 1 to 6, Definition 1, Proposition 1, or its proof
columns.name: for an equation, a label given by the record; for the definition and the proposition, the title the article gives them; empty for the proof
columns.form: latex for an equation; text with LaTeX mathematics for the others
columns.content: the equation or the statement, from the manuscript source

tables.what: Glossary of the symbols. Written for this record from the article's definitions; not a passage of the article.

columns.latex: the symbol in LaTeX, in a form that occurs in the manuscript source

tables.what: Beyond the article: for each prediction, how it could be found wrong. Baselines 2022 and 2026; first reading on data for 2027, final reading on data for 2032. No reading has been taken.

columns.id: identifier of the test, T1 to T11
columns.refers_to: what the test is about: layer:N for the prediction on layer N; claim:central for the central claim as stated in the introduction; table:X<Y for two rows of Table 1 where the net sign of X is lower than that of Y
columns.article_says: the sentence or the net signs of the article that the test refers to, taken from the other tables
columns.public_sources: the kind of public source it can be read from; no series has been chosen
columns.baseline: the first year the change is measured from, 2022; for T7 to T11 an average of three years ending then
columns.second_baseline: the second year the change is measured from, 2026, the year the tests were written; the verdict is taken from this one
columns.first_reading: the year of the data for the first reading
columns.final_reading: the year of the data for the final reading, at which the verdict is taken
columns.counts_against: the outcome at the final reading that would count against the paper
columns.does_not_count: an outcome that looks similar and would not count against the paper, with the reason
